data.name: Two Dollar Suits
data.detailed_description:
Impactful Combat

Experience forceful and heavy top-down combat with great movement fluidity. Tactically combine weapons and skills to find your ideal combat style. Face an aggressive police force head-on, utilizing a complex dynamic gore system with pixel-level details.

Intricate Levels

Every map is one big puzzle. Missions contain varying security measures with many clever solutions. Figuring out how the obstacles are connected is essential for a successful ghost approach.

Exploratory

Discover opportunities and adapt your strategies for each map. Use the environment to your advantage by opening new paths with explosives, discovering hidden entrances, and luring enemies into dangerous traps.

Endless Replayability

With 50 heists, dozens of skills and equipment, and several approaches for each map, players will never run out of ways to surpass their past attempts at the perfect crime.

Narrative-Driven

Reveal Logan Huntborn's devastating mistakes by traveling through a reflection of history. Witness Logan's attempts to save others from the misery he himself has endured, and fight for freedom from the hellscape they call home.

The story explores the themes of loss, regret, and consequences as your family struggles with the complex nature of the criminal underworld. The city of San Dinero is home to many stories, and contains an abundance of interconnected journeys to discover.

data.short_description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Athlon 200GE or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT 1050 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains violence and mild mature language. Illegal drugs is encountered on some missions. All violence is stylized with pixel graphics.
